body: 13 YEARS. that's how long we've waited for taylor to sing at the CMAs again, and it's happening wednesday 🥹 2013 gave us that acoustic red set. 2026 gives us a single of the year nominee in the room. nov 18, ABC + disney+ https://longlivets.com/?era=red&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news

critique.rationale: Confirmed same-day news with the exact 13-year gap (the 2013 acoustic "Red") and the Single of the Year nod carrying it. A Red-launch-week GMA photo ties the 2013 song to the return.

why: Event news, intake #6840: the CMAs/ABC confirmed on 2026-11-13 that Taylor performs at the 60th CMA Awards (Nov 18), her first CMA performance since 2013. Free day, no displacement: 11-14 15:00Z (11-13 23:00Z was under 3h away). X half written first; hook = the number.
